source: ISO 32000-2:2020 as amended by Errata Collection 3
scope: Selected review of catalog/FDF dictionary import tables 245, 246 and 249. Focus is version resolution and valid FDF Encoding reaching field-name matching, choice-option labels, and field-value writeback; not whole FDF certification.

source_tables.caption_check: Caption and Version on574; required FDF row continues575 before Table246.

selected_cells.rule: Required catalog entry; its value is the FDF dictionary in Table 246. The required /FDF row continues onto physical 575.
Optional, PDF 1.4 name. It states a version later than the file header; otherwise the header controls. The version is a name object.

source_tables.errata: No direct Table 245 cell change identified. #176 changes §12.7.8.1 media-type wording, not catalog cells. EC3 #173 clarifies the nearby encrypted-EmbeddedFDF prose and does not change Version/FDF. #264 adds punctuation in §12.7.8.3.1.
source_tables.code_assertions: FormsData::read requires the FDF catalog dictionary and obtains effective version from Document::version. `forms_data.rs::the_version_an_fdf_conforms_to_is_the_later_of_its_header_and_its_entry` checks later/earlier/absent Version with canonical %FDF-1.2 header. The promoted public FDF page-import fixture uses %FDF-1.2 plus catalog /Version /1.4, respecting §12.7.8.2.2 and the Version entry's later-version condition.
source_tables.verdict: Selected Version behavior has a literal unit oracle and a corrected public import fixture; no distinct gap identified. The public test does not imply all malformed-header cases require rejection.

source_tables.caption_check: Table 246 begins physical 575 and continues through physical 576; the text mentioning its caption on physical 574 is preceding prose.

selected_cells.rule: Optional pair of byte strings identifying source/target file.
Optional root field array; writer must not combine it with Pages.
Optional PDFDocEncoded status string to display; writer must not combine with Pages.
Optional PDF1.3 page dictionaries; neither Fields nor Status shall be present with Pages (producer construction rule, not mandatory reader rejection).
Optional PDF 1.3 encoding for string field values/options/names without a U+FEFF prefix. Default PDFDocEncoding. Listed alternatives include Shift_JIS, BigFive, GBK, UHC, utf_8 and utf_16.
Optional FDF annotation array with the listed subtype exclusions.
Optional PDF 1.4 incremental-update stream, with trust relationship to signature data described in the cell.
Optional PDF 1.4 embedded FDF file specifications.

source_tables.errata: EC3 #173 targets the immediately following encryption prose and clarifies deprecation is FDF file encryption, not EmbeddedFDFs generally. #264 is punctuation in §12.7.8.3.1; #176 is MIME media-type wording. No direct replacement of Table 246 cells identified.

implementation_assertion_map.F_ID: FormsData::source/identifier and forms_data.rs file-identifier tests; Table 43 file specification parser supports string/dictionary forms.
implementation_assertion_map.Fields: read_fields + ViewState::import; current FDF field tests cover options/flags/value replacement and matching, including same-name widgets and writeback.
implementation_assertion_map.Status: read/display path has `fdf_status_consumer_audit.rs`, comparing present-status message to absent control.
implementation_assertion_map.Pages: FDF template count, field, named-page and public page-import tests; save persistence remains expressly departed/reported under ADR 2154.
implementation_assertion_map.Encoding: Encoding::read maps utf_8 and utf_16 to Unicode, but Encoding::decode delegates to pdf_syntax::text_string, which treats no-BOM bytes as PDFDocEncoding. The public `fdf_utf8_import_spec_audit.rs` tests `utf8_non_bom_field_name_matches_the_target_on_import` and `utf8_non_bom_value_is_transcoded_on_import_and_save`: parent execution wave119 reports both fail (field import count 1 rather than 2; saved value `Ã©` rather than `é`), while `ascii_utf8_field_import_is_a_positive_control` and `utf16_bom_overrides_the_fdf_encoding_for_names_and_values` pass. `/Opt` also reaches this decode path through `forms_data.rs::options`; the scratch choice-label test covers it but is unrun.
implementation_assertion_map.Annots: Table 254 Page ordinal import/writeback tests; unsupported subtype handling is implementation policy, not inferred as mandatory reader refusal.
implementation_assertion_map.Differences: Presence is named in `owed`; no signed-trust application is claimed by this selected review.
implementation_assertion_map.Target: Parsed field exists but no browser-frame host consumer is asserted; no browser-frame behavior is required by the current viewer host scope in this review.
implementation_assertion_map.EmbeddedFDFs: Nested FDF and independent per-file Encoding/Status tests exist; recursion/resource limits are explicit and reported.
implementation_assertion_map.JavaScript: Table 248 public event-order test exercises Doc, Before, After and AfterPermsReady with runner-provided callbacks.

source_tables.verdict: Confirmed bounded valid-input behavior gap for Table 246 /Encoding across Table 249 /T and string /V: the parent’s exact-xref public tests fail on non-BOM UTF-8 and pass ASCII/BOM controls. A scratch exact-xref /Opt consumer test is drafted but not yet run. This is one shared decoding behavior, not separate findings for each consumer.
related_adrs: ADR 2816 (FDF scripts; unrelated to character decoding)
residuals: The scratch /Opt test covers simple-string option entries, ASCII and UTF-16-BOM controls, and save-back; it remains unexecuted.
utf_16 without a BOM and registered Shift_JIS/BigFive/GBK/UHC paths need separate source-derived positive coverage or explicit implementation disposition.
The Table 246 producer-only exclusions Fields+Pages and Status+Pages do not prescribe reader rejection; this review does not test them.

source_tables.caption_check: Table 249 caption and entries begin physical 578; the prior FDF-fields heading/prose on physical 577 is not the table itself.

selected_cells.rule: Required partial field name; Table 246 Encoding applies to string field names that do not begin with U+FEFF.
Optional typed field value; if a corresponding entry is imported it replaces the target field entry. Table 246 Encoding applies when this value is a non-BOM string.
Full Ff replaces and suppresses set/clear companions; otherwise set then clear as table says.
Required for choice fields; the option label and optional default appearance string pair are interpreted by the field type.
AP entry takes precedence; APRef is ignored if AP is present. APRef named-page handling is already audited separately.

source_tables.implementation_assertions: `forms_data::read_fields/read_field` form fully-qualified names and read typed values; `ViewState::import` matches target fields and `ViewState::save` writes updates. `forms_data.rs::options` decodes each Table 249 /Opt string (including the first string of a two-item option/DA pair) through the Table 246 Encoding value; `ViewState::import` exposes labels and selected indices through `pdf_model::form::fields`, while `ViewState::save` writes updated `/Opt`. Existing `fdf_field_dictionary_audit.rs` checks ASCII option replacement/save, not non-BOM UTF-8. Scratch `fdf_utf8_choice_options_spec_audit.rs` adds public label/selection and save assertions with ASCII/BOM controls; unrun.
source_tables.verdict: The runtime gap is confirmed for /T and string /V by parent execution; the source and call path establish /Opt as the same shared Table 246 decoding gap, with a discriminating public regression drafted but not yet executed.
residuals: No other Table 249 cells are certified by this selected audit; existing mapped assertions are cited only to show the encoding-specific gap is distinct.

execution: Parent ran the original four tests in crates/pdf-model/tests/fdf_utf8_import_spec_audit.rs during fdf-wave119: ASCII and UTF-16-BOM controls passed; no-BOM UTF-8 /T and /V cases failed; Clippy passed. Parent integrated this review's three /Opt cases into that file and reports the combined seven-test target is running. This reviewer did not run Cargo; the scratch duplicate in drafts/ remains unexecuted.
parent_execution: B75: seven tests run, four PASS and three FAIL. Non-BOM UTF8 T mismatches the target; V saves mojibake; Opt shows/saves mojibake and loses the selected choice. ASCII and UTF16-BOM controls pass. Draft/pending statements below are superseded by this execution and parent-review.json.
